description: Four-band splitter and mixer: one signal cut into four bands, each with its own level, send and return, then summed back together

params.text: Sets the level of the low band below 300Hz before it is sent out
Sets the level of the low mid band around 750Hz before it is sent out
Sets the level of the high mid band around 1500Hz before it is sent out
Sets the level of the high band above 3000Hz before it is sent out

inputs.text: A signal into that band alone, added to whatever is at ALL IN
The signal for that band coming back from an effect; with nothing patched here the band's own send is used instead, unless that send has a cable of its own
Scales the level of that band, 0-10V from silence to the level its slider sets; with nothing patched the level is whatever the slider says
A signal fed into all four bands at once
Scales the whole mix, 0-10V from silence to full; with nothing patched the mix runs at full level

outputs.text: That band alone after its filter and level, taken out of the mix unless its return is patched
The four band returns added together and scaled by the mix level, soft-clipped at -10V to 10V

notes: with the module bypassed every input is summed straight to the mix output with no filtering
menu: Soft clip at ±10V — saturates the mix output rather than letting it run past 10V; on by default
